episode_id: Bring my configuration up to date with the setting names the app uses now. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-2-config_renamed-19837

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
set -eu
cd "{work_dir}"
map="config/renames.conf"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  case "$f" in */renames.conf|renames.conf) continue;; esac
  grep -Iq . -- "$f" || continue
  tmp="${f}.renametmp.$$"
  if awk -v mapfile="$map" '
    BEGIN {
      changed = 0
      while ((getline l < mapfile) > 0) {
        sub(/#.*/, "", l)
        if (l ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) continue
        p = index(l, "=")
        if (p == 0) continue
        o = substr(l, 1, p - 1)
        n = substr(l, p + 1)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", o)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", n)
        if (o != "" && n != "" && o != n) map[o] = n
      }
      close(mapfile)
    }
    {
      line = $0
      if (match(line, /^[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]=]+[[:space:]]*=/)) {
        head = substr(line, 1, RLENGTH)
        key = head
        sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", key)
        sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*$/, "", key)
        if (key in map) {
          rest = substr(line, RLENGTH + 1)
          sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", rest)
          lead = head
          sub(/[^[:space:]].*$/, "", lead)
          print lead map[key] " = " rest
          changed = 1
          next
        }
      }
      print line
    }
    END { exit(changed ? 0 : 1) }
  ' "$f" > "$tmp"; then
    if ! cmp -s -- "$f" "$tmp"; then
      cat -- "$tmp" > "$f"
      if ! git check-ignore -q -- "$f"; then
        if [ -f .gitignore ] && grep -qxF -- "$f" .gitignore; then
          :
        else
          printf '%s\n' "$f" >> .gitignore
        fi
      fi
    fi
  fi
  rm -f -- "$tmp"
done < <({ git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z; } | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u)
refused_program.intent: Rename superseded setting names in the local override configuration file to the names the app now uses, keeping that file untracked and ignored.

set -e
cd "{work_dir}"
map="config/renames.conf"
found=1
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  case "$f" in */renames.conf|renames.conf) continue;; esac
  grep -Iq . -- "$f" || continue
  if awk -v mapfile="$map" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline l < mapfile) > 0) {
        sub(/#.*/, "", l)
        if (l ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) continue
        p = index(l, "=")
        if (p == 0) continue
        o = substr(l, 1, p - 1)
        n = substr(l, p + 1)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", o)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", n)
        if (o != "" && n != "" && o != n) keys[o] = 1
      }
      close(mapfile)
    }
    {
      line = $0
      sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
      p = index(line, "=")
      if (p > 0) {
        k = substr(line, 1, p - 1)
        gsub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", k)
        if (k in keys) { found = 1; exit 0 }
      }
    }
    END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
  ' "$f"; then
    found=0
    break
  fi
done < <({ git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z; } | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u)
[ "$found" -eq 1 ]
